title: NAKED 100 E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill – Brain Freeze
description:
Naked 100 Brain Freeze is a delightful mixture of fruit flavours with a cool icy kick. Strawberry Kiwi and pomegranate come together for a unique fruit blend flavour like no other satisfying your palate on each vape followed with an icy kick on exhale for a perfect finish. Brain Freeze is a complex and unique flavour made is California USA.
Naked 100 Brain Freeze comes in 60ml bottle with 10ml space to add one nicotine shot for 3mg strength.
Naked 100 are manufactured in US California and they carry menthol fruit, tobacco and cream flavour with high VG concentration for premium quality eliquid.
Nicotine Level:
Zero – 0mg
VG/PG:
70% VG 30% PG
Bottle Size:
60ml filled with 50ml to add your nicotine shot
